context.analysis:
## Overview
The Clinic Management System is a hybrid cloud platform designed to manage patient admissions, electronic medical records, scheduling, and billing for medium-sized hospitals and clinics. It ensures HIPAA and GDPR compliance while maintaining high availability and sub-second performance.

## Key Elements
- **Actors:** Patient, Clinician (Doctors/Nurses), Billing/Admin Staff, Compliance Officer
- **Internal Systems:** Clinic Management System spanning `on-prem-k8s` and `eu-central-1`
- **External Systems:** Lab & Imaging Systems, Insurance Clearinghouse / External Billing Provider
- **Containers/Infrastructure:** Microservices mesh, active-active databases, secure secrets manager with HSM, CI/CD pipeline with runtime scanning

## Relationships
- **Actors to Clinic Management System:** HTTPS (TLS 1.3, OAuth2/OIDC, MFA)
- **Clinic Management System to Lab & Imaging Systems:** HL7 FHIR over REST/JSON (TLS 1.3)
- **Clinic Management System to Insurance Clearinghouse:** HTTPS / EDI X12
- **Internal Hybrid Interconnect (`on-prem-k8s` to `eu-central-1`):** mTLS and IPsec VPN tunnels

## Technology Stack
- **Infrastructure:** Hybrid Kubernetes (`on-prem-k8s` and AWS `eu-central-1`) for active-active multi-region deployment and scalability
- **Security & Cryptography:** AES-256 for data-at-rest with customer-managed keys (CMK) via Hardware Security Modules (HSM); TLS 1.3 and mTLS for data-in-transit
- **Authentication & Authorization:** OAuth2/OIDC with multi-factor authentication (MFA) and Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC)
- **Interoperability Standards:** HL7 FHIR (REST/JSON) and EDI X12 for external integrations

## Rationale
This architecture guarantees 99.99% active-active availability and sub-second EMR performance by combining edge-proximate on-premises Kubernetes with AWS cloud resources. Strict zero-trust microsegmentation, mTLS, and AES-256 encryption fulfill stringent HIPAA, GDPR, and 10-year audit retention mandates without compromising clinical workflows.

containers.analysis:
## Overview
[The Clinic Management System is a hybrid cloud platform designed to manage patient admissions, electronic medical records, scheduling, and billing for medium-sized hospitals and clinics while ensuring HIPAA and GDPR compliance.]
[The architecture utilizes decoupled microservices, secure API gateways, and tiered data storage to deliver 99.99% availability and high-performance clinical workflows.]

## Key Elements
• Patient Portal SPA/Mobile
• Clinician/Admin Workspace SPA
• API Gateway / BFF (Envoy/Kong)
• Core Services Container
• Billing Service Container
• Integration Service Container
• Audit & Compliance Logging Container
• PostgreSQL & HL7 FHIR Compliant Data Stores
• RabbitMQ/Kafka Message Broker

## Relationships
• Patient / Clinician / Billing Staff / Compliance Officer -> API Gateway / BFF via HTTPS (TLS 1.3, OAuth2/OIDC, MFA)
• API Gateway / BFF -> Presentation & Core Containers via gRPC over mTLS
• Core Services Container -> PostgreSQL via JDBC (AES-256 at rest)
• Billing Service Container -> RabbitMQ/Kafka via AMQP
• Integration Service Container -> Lab & Imaging Systems via HL7 FHIR over REST/JSON (TLS 1.3)
• Clinic Management System -> Insurance Clearinghouse via HTTPS / EDI X12

## Technology Stack
• React/TypeScript: High-performance frontend user interfaces for distinct personas
• Java/Spring Boot: Robust domain logic for core clinical services
• Node.js/TypeScript: Isolated financial and billing processing
• Envoy/Kong: API gateway for reverse proxy, routing, and token exchange
• PostgreSQL: Relational persistence with AES-256 encryption at rest
• Apache Camel / Spring Integration: HL7 FHIR translation adapters for interoperability
• RabbitMQ/Kafka: Asynchronous messaging for resilient insurance claim submissions
• Istio/Linkerd: Service mesh enforcing mTLS across hybrid boundaries

## Rationale
[This architecture cleanly separates user-facing frontends and heavy billing tasks from core EMR services to guarantee sub-second performance under high loads.]
[Distributed hybrid deployments, WORM-compliant storage, and comprehensive service mesh security fulfill stringent 99.99% availability and 10-year regulatory compliance mandates.]

## Overview
The Clinic Management System is a hybrid cloud platform designed to manage patient admissions, electronic medical records, scheduling, and billing for medium-sized hospitals and clinics. It ensures strict HIPAA and GDPR compliance while maintaining 99.99% availability and supporting high-performance clinical workflows.

## Key Elements
- **Patients, Clinicians, Billing/Admin Staff, Compliance Officer** (Human Actors)
- **Lab & Imaging Systems, Insurance Clearinghouse / External Billing Provider** (External Systems)
- **Patient Portal SPA/Mobile, Clinician/Admin Workspace SPA** (React/TypeScript Frontends)
- **API Gateway / BFF** (Envoy/Kong)
- **Core Services Container** (Java/Spring Boot)
- **Billing Service Container** (Node.js/TypeScript)
- **Integration Service Container** (Apache Camel / Spring Integration)
- **Audit & Compliance Logging Container** (WORM-compliant storage / Spring Integration)
- **PostgreSQL & HL7 FHIR Compliant Data Stores** (PostgreSQL with AES-256 at rest)
- **Message Broker** (RabbitMQ/Kafka)

## Relationships
- Users -> API Gateway / BFF: HTTPS (TLS 1.3, OAuth2/OIDC, MFA)
- API Gateway / BFF -> Core Services Container / Billing Service Container: gRPC over mTLS
- Core Services Container -> PostgreSQL & HL7 FHIR Compliant Data Stores: JDBC (AES-256 at rest)
- Billing Service Container -> Message Broker: AMQP
- Integration Service Container -> Lab & Imaging Systems: HL7 FHIR over REST/JSON (TLS 1.3)
- Billing Service Container -> Insurance Clearinghouse / External Billing Provider: HTTPS / EDI X12

## Technology Stack
- **React/TypeScript:** High-performance SPAs for patient and clinician workspaces ensuring responsive UI.
- **Java/Spring Boot:** Robust domain logic execution for core clinical services.
- **Node.js/TypeScript:** Lightweight isolated handling for financial and billing services.

- **Apache Camel / Spring Integration:** Translation adapters for HL7 FHIR interoperability.
- **RabbitMQ/Kafka:** Asynchronous messaging for resilient claim submissions.

## Rationale
This hybrid architecture isolates critical clinical and financial workloads across on-premises Kubernetes and cloud regions to meet strict data retention and security mandates. Utilizing microservices with gRPC over mTLS, event-driven messaging, and HL7 FHIR integration ensures high availability (99.99%), scalability, and seamless interoperability.
